_doc: Each rule's placements, oldest first (R070, 2026-11-14). The last placement equals the rule in backend/gate/lock_codes.py RULES. A change of owner, source or split_from appends a placement that carries a later since (stops added or moved: the weekly reference nets it) or a written no_stop_change (a wording or refactor with the same stops). A rule leaving RULES appends {"retired": date}. tests/test_rule_placements.py reads it. Placements marked initial were taken from RULES on 2026-11-14.

halt_m4_drawdown.source: M4 rule 1, l0_portfolio.HALT_DRAWDOWN: realised equity off its peak (live, cycle level)

loss_cap.source: M4 rule 2 in live (l0_portfolio.HALT_LOSS_CAP, cycle level); wallet.execute_trade's fixed-dollar cap in demo

halt_m4_expectancy.source: M4 rule 3, l0_portfolio.HALT_EXPECTANCY: the trailing sample's expectancy (live, cycle level)

drawdown_guard.source: chain.py mechanical pre-L5 guard (reason ends '(mechanical pre-L5 guard)')

blocklist.source: gate_runner_live: the live blocklist, before the chain

position_open.source: both runners before the chain, and the execution re-check (gate_runner_live, wallet)

cooloff.source: both runners, before the chain: a recent L4/L6 stop (the gate cooloff; before 2026-10-31 SKIPPED_COOLOFF also held the exit cooloff)

exit_cooloff.source: both runners, before the chain: the ticker's own recent exit other than a TP/TSL win (db.get_recently_exited_*tickers; until phase 3 it also held the win window, as history rows do)

exit_cooloff_win.source: both runners, before the chain: the ticker's own recent TP/TSL win (its own rule from phase 3, Niclas 2026-10-31: "egen regel låter mer konsekvent"; history before it is under exit_cooloff)

regime.source: l1_eligibility fail_type: the regime module's verdict on the sector

macro_pre_event.source: l1_eligibility data key; the penalty bites at the score re-test (chain.py)

notional_too_small.source: the order cannot buy: before the chain on the largest possible notional, and at execution (live < $10 or no whole share, demo < $50)

price_missing.source: before the chain and at execution: no price

earnings_near.source: l2_risk.check_earnings data key; the penalty bites at the score re-test (chain.py); never fired

etf.source: l2_risk.check_etf, called by chain.py after L5 (FILTERED_ETF_PENALTY before 2026-10-31)

overflow.source: gate_runner*.py execution phase: a position beyond l2_risk_max_positions_count needs the escalated score; a free slot passes

max_positions.source: wallet.execute_trade: demo max positions without an overflow slot

grok.source: l4_sentiment: Grok's verdict (score at or below the minimum, or low conviction)

leading.source: l5_positioning: the leading-indicator checks (price and options groups; 2 of 4 before 2026-06-03)

claude.source: l6_review: Claude's decision (HOLD, or confidence below the minimum)

broker_error.source: gate_runner_live: the broker refused the approved order

broker_unknown.source: gate_runner_live: the submit raised and the readback by client order id failed too, so whether the order stands is unknown; fail closed and cooled until reconciled (2026-11-14, order item 7c)
